Hello, we visited the tower location and vicinity and we don’t want to be in a big tower, so please cancel the viewing for this particular property. 

Would you have any other properties that could suit our requirements please?  for reference,
we are looking for a 1 to 6-month rental in Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Downtown, 2BR, pet-friendly with a monthly budget of AED 15k max. Many thanks Marie
